title: Peo e nnye
description: Mo motseng o o mo ditshitshing tsa Thaba ya Kenya, go ne go na le mosetsana yo o neng a dira mo masimong le mmaagwe. O ne a tshwenyega fa a bona dikgwa tse dikgolo di nyelela, fela o ne a itse ka matla peo e nnye.
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
